provenance: gnomAD v4 allele frequencies for the 77 variants of PGS000001 - the page scores 1000 Genomes genotypes, which carry no blanket redistribution licence, so a CC0 reference population stands in. Each point is one variant of the score itself, so this is the same modality from a different cohort, not a different measurement.
attribution: Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD) v4, Broad Institute. CC0 - no attribution is required; it is given because the data is worth crediting.
note: 64 of 77 variants resolved in gnomAD v4. The diagonal is ancestry-invariant; distance from it is the portability problem in its raw form. 8 of the 32 larger-effect variants differ by at least 0.20 in allele frequency between the two groups - and PGS000001's development cohort was 100% European, so those are the weights doing the damage. This is the mechanism behind the ancestry-strata chart above, not a second finding.
